Method of Attack: The package abuses legitimate npm components to bundle within itself a malicious, hard-to-detect Linux and Mac executable. It also attempts to damage mission-critical system files, perform extensive reconnaissance and fingerprinting, and perform data exfiltration.
Attack Vector: The package requests root privileges from the user, thus allowing it to conduct its nefarious activities. This is facilitated by a post-install script that launches a 'run' binary. The malware then copies itself to /etc/rot1, where it gains persistence and subsequently runs on every boot.
Indicators of Compromise: The package issues multiple 'systemctl' commands to stop critical system services and deletes the /etc/systemd/system/ directory.
Attempts to wipe clean the /etc/ directory, which contains critical system configuration files, password hashes, DNS rules, etc.
Copies itself to /etc/rot1, gaining persistence and running on every boot.
Makes HTTP connections every few seconds to the me.ejemplo[.]me domain to exfiltrate information.
